title: Woman in Flower Garden, 1942 Sepia Snapshot, Philadelphia
back_text_transcription:
KEY-TONE Panel-Art PRINT MADE BY KEYSTONE ROLL FILM SERVICE PHILADELPHIA, PENNA. APR 29 1942
239 U
description: A vintage 1942 sepia snapshot featuring a woman wearing a 1940s buttoned dress and hat, holding a dark coat and handbag while standing in front of a terraced stone wall overflowing with blooming flowers. The reverse side bears a light red photo developer stamp reading 'KEY-TONE Panel-Art PRINT / MADE BY KEYSTONE ROLL FILM SERVICE / PHILADELPHIA, PENNA. / APR 29 1942' alongside a printed code '239 U'.
